scope: Complete PS5 runtime core, renderer, memory and services for Android and native macOS direct FEX with a shared static Metal backend; desktop dashboard and updater excluded.

cpu_engine.darwin_host_adaptation: Mach VM inventory preserves current permissions across concurrent adjacent-region coalescing; no FEX vendor modification.

host_adaptations: Android ARM64 signal context, guarded native crash diagnostics and original GPU fault handling
Direct x86 CPU calls, SysV typed HLE, callbacks, TLS, thread cancellation and fibers
Original shared VM backing with the Gen4 Android host address-space bound
Android window, IME and existing controller integration
Portable original shader-resource evaluator with an ARM64 SRT walker enabled by default
Default-enabled empty-signal fast path, indexed typed HLE dispatch and asynchronous driver cache persistence, with individual off selectors
Final SPIR-V fragment-barycentric admission against the enabled device feature

Default-enabled conditional geometry-assisted fragment barycentric coordinates and raw PerVertexKHR arrays for validated triangle-list and canonicalized triangle-strip pipelines; native capability is not advertised
Device-qualified mesh subgroup selection and required subgroup size preserve guest wave64 coverage within native mesh invocation limits

Mesh barycentric coordinates and raw corners use shared vertex staging and per-primitive data within device limits; compact center interpolation uses viewport/FragCoord reconstruction, while centroid, sample and dual-mode coordinates retain homogeneous varyings
Build, localization and correctness fixtures

Default-enabled bounded case-insensitive directory indexes avoid repeated full scans for negative path probes; exact-case lookup, metadata validation and namespace invalidation are preserved, with an explicit zero rollback

Optional on-demand render timing separates native queue submission, queue locking and renderer/completion waits without enabling per-frame logs or changing synchronization; matching ReadGuestMemory/WriteGuestMemory faults have distinct diagnostic origins from other watched accesses
Default-enabled bounded RELEASE_MEM submission batching preserves packet-order callbacks and flushes at waits, host work, flips, indirect execution and command-stream boundaries
Native video plane publication executes atomically on the renderer owner after retiring prior GPU ownership, while texture edge tracking preserves CPU invalidation baselines

Default-enabled proven uniform GPU metadata avoids synchronous color metadata downloads while preserving ordered GPU writes, alias and backing generation checks, conservative invalidation and explicit zero rollback
Audio sample-clock recovery discards lateness beyond one block, preserving sub-block jitter and fractional cadence without repeatedly consuming a stale guest ring after burst device backpressure

Android direct-FEX native builds outside Debug omit Tracy profiler instrumentation; disabled lifecycle functions and macros retain no Tracy references or argument evaluation, while Debug, desktop and legacy defaults remain unchanged

Device-qualified optional buffer 64-bit atomics with guest shader requirement checks, including shared-memory storage-buffer lowering; Android fatal errors remain visible in logcat when ordinary diagnostics are disabled
Native macOS ARM64 direct FEX: 16 KiB host protection aggregation, ARM fault context, non-overwriting Mach reservations and guest data/JIT separation

Native macOS Metal uses the shared Gen4 static adapter and pinned SPIRV-Cross MSL, with a Vulkan 1.2 internal interface plus supported extensions and owned SDL Metal surfaces; no external Vulkan loader is used

Capability-qualified null image descriptors specialize shader reads and queries to typed zero and discard writes and atomics; variant identities, indirect descriptor selection and cache-owned placeholder lifetime preserve isolation
Metal capability admission occurs at the consuming shader, pipeline or view, with explicit buffer and optional image bounds; required non-Metal Vulkan and Android feature gates are preserved
Native Metal correctness fixtures cover compute and graphics readback, viewport state, production presentation and surface recreation, null descriptor isolation and host-page-aware memory transfers

Darwin image faults preserve the exact touched byte separately from host-page watch coverage; existing edge baselines cover the opened 16 KiB host edges while disjoint GPU-authoritative images and watched interiors are retained

Native Metal primitive-stage fixtures exercise triangle and quad tessellation, fractional and asymmetric factors, production Gen5 rect-list expansion, per-primitive multi-component cull distances, indexed and instanced draws, and guarded GPU readback with resource reuse.

AGC startup retains the fixed logical driver/table addresses through separate watched native aliases; initialization is repeatable, CPU instrumentation and GPU/BDA readback use the same backing, and failed address admission still rolls back direct memory and GPU/virtual metadata.

Darwin direct ARM64 address translation is limited to verified permanent OS commpage and GPU-carveout reservations with current and maximum protection NONE; the final 32 MiB commpage nesting interval, ordinary user guards, PAGEZERO and unrelated host mappings remain excluded.

Immutable 16 KiB-aligned host arenas retain logical guest addresses in VM metadata, shader identities and BDA keys. Atomic semantic-rights admission and inverse fault translation preserve original permissions and GPU watches for FEX-generated and native ARM64 accesses; supported scalar/SIMD, LSE/CAS and DC ZVA instructions are decoded, while unknown opcodes, unaligned atomics and LL/SC exclusives fail closed. Nonidentity guest executable mappings remain rejected.

Native file and socket I/O stages nonidentity guest buffers through checked user-space reads and writes, including bounded vector and output publication, so kernel copyin/copyout cannot bypass watched-alias GPU coherence; identity I/O remains unchanged.

The unresolved-object loader sentinel accepts a relocated allocation when its preferred hint is occupied, preserves the occupied mapping, and remains NoAccess across the full native page; relocations consistently use the actual returned address.

Translated semantic protection changes publish the intersection of old and new access rights while native permissions and metadata are updated, preserving valid concurrent readers during RW-to-R or RW-to-RW transitions; watch removal remains bounded by guest permissions.

Naturally aligned scalar transfers of 1, 2, 4 and 8 bytes use native relaxed atomic loads/stores, including individual GPR pair elements and SIMD transfers up to 8 bytes, with the original ordering fences; unaligned byte-copy behavior is retained.

Apple direct FEX startup preloads only the declared static DT_NEEDED dependency closure before relocation, tracks dependency references, initializes dependencies once before consumers, and finalizes in reverse successful initialization order. Existing loadstart/stopunload paths share this state; original Android and other non-Apple-direct paths are preserved.

Allocation-free complete-span CPU permission queries are enabled for every direct host and title with independent exact-0 rollback; they preserve the VM transaction lock, watched guest view, full preflight and mapping lifetime while guest-copy entry points avoid a redundant recursive lock

Experimental exact ordinary SRT reads are disabled by default on every direct host and title after observed startup regressions. Explicit LUMEN_PS5_SRT_EXACT_READBACK=1 enables synchronization of intersecting GPU-dirty bytes and complete readable shared-backing copies after mapping-lifetime rechecks; private or ineligible memory retains watched reads. The same selector enables a separate checked ARM64 walker entry with scalar callback ABI, memoized nested pointers and bounded W^X publication. The default or explicit zero retains the raw entry and existing portable callback behavior; failed checked allocation or eligibility retains the appropriate fallback.
Pure IR value and instruction observers are inline to remove repeated cross-unit calls without changing resolution, operand storage or validation.
Existing region and page tracking locks use read-only contended polling before retrying the acquire exchange; owner checks, release publication and native protection transactions are unchanged.

Native SRT refresh is restricted to a fresh evaluation session; later evaluations preserve the complete portable memo including root pointers and unknown values. A failed native refresh makes that session terminal, while a fresh session can retry.
Device-qualified fragment subgroup size32 preserves guest wave32 EXEC and VCC mask indexing; guest wave64 and unsupported fragment size control retain the native subgroup policy.

Unified-memory renderer budgets reserve capacity for guest and host memory, refresh Vulkan budget estimates at collection boundaries, and cap dynamic cache collection thresholds; original texture retention ages are preserved and collection waits for the complete minimum age.

Android presentation defers surface recreation while the native window is absent, protects SDL native-window lifetime during recreation, and recovers transient surface loss without reusing an already submitted presentation frame.

barycentric_fallback.scope: Validated fill-only triangle-list/canonicalized triangle-strip VS/GS/PS and triangle mesh/PS coordinates and PerVertexKHR. Geometry supports array[3] scalar/vector32 raw inputs; mesh supports float32 vec4 ordinary inputs and array[3] float32 vec4 raw inputs within device component/shared/output limits. Compact mesh transport requires at most one center coordinate mode and no sample shading; other supported coordinate qualifiers retain homogeneous transport. No tessellation, multiview, mesh PrimitiveId or unsupported coordinate pointer escapes.

android_runtime_default.scope: all titles; device and shader admission remains conditional

selective_updates.scope: Selected shader semantics and compiler work, sampled resource pairs and 64-bit guards, single-store PM4 publication, filesystem sync and libc ABI fixes; not a complete upstream revision update. Existing ARM64/Metal adaptations and cumulative runtime defaults preserved.

commits.subject: shader: drop the duplicate-use scan from Inst::AddUse
shader: seal SSA blocks once their predecessors are filled
shader: decode s_dcache_inv as a no-op
shader: clamp V_FRACT_F16/F32/F64 results below one
shader: read lane 0 in V_READFIRSTLANE when EXEC is zero instead of an undefined lane
shader: extract 9-bit NGG primitive vertex indices, leaving the edge flags out
shader: mask V_MAD_U64_U32 carry-out bits of lanes outside EXEC
shader: decode the SHARED_LIMIT and PRIVATE_LIMIT inline constants
kernel: implement POSIX fsync through the shared file API
libc: fix swapped strcmp/strncmp NIDs and bind strcpy to its own NID instead of strcpy_s's
kernel: send _write to descriptors 0-2 through KernelWrite instead of dropping it
graphics: publish each PM4 WRITE_DATA word exactly once
shader: remove artificial sampled image and sampler pair limit
shader: retain resource guards for 64-bit scalar comparisons
